testCase.name: [本地] S20 Task toggles in both contexts are named with their task and expose done / not done; axe on the task screens

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20

思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S20 「两个模式下任务开关的名字都带着它的任务，并暴露完成 / 没完成；任务界面跑 axe」 Task toggles in both contexts are named with their task and expose done / not done; axe on the task screens

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 Tasks closed by dictation show as completed, with the visit they were closed on（TFA-92585 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Hospital and Nursing Home charts with one open and one closed task; Post-Round → Tasks and Task Export (Finished Tasks expanded)

When Visual lane runs axe-core on each screen (desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15)

Then Every task toggle on the four screens has an accessible name that contains the task text and exposes its state (aria-pressed or aria-checked); no serious or critical axe violation; whether done is shown by colour or strike-through alone goes to a person

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：A scripted DOM check on each screen: for every task toggle, accessible name ⊇ task text and aria-pressed / aria-checked present and matching the stored done state (WCAG 4.1.2). Expected Fail on main for the Nursing Home Post-Round toggles (no name, no state) and both Task Export screens (title 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' only: no task text, no state); …

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92585 ready for pr；TFA-92592 ready for pr

用读屏的医生在养老院 Post-Round 任务和 Task Export 上，每个任务按钮听起来都一样，分不清是哪个任务、做没做完。

A screen-reader user on the Nursing Home Post-Round tasks or on Task Export hears the same unnamed button for every task and cannot tell which task it is or whether it is done.

依据：allure-results/d6815fdc…: 6 pass / 30 fail across 3 profiles. Hospital Post-Round toggles pass ('Complete task: …' / 'Reopen task: …' with aria-pressed). NH Post-Round toggles have no name and no state. Both Task Export screens say 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' with no task text and no aria-pressed (WCAG 4.1.2).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S20

Task toggles in both contexts are named with their task and expose done / not done; axe on the task screens

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr); TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：encounter.spec.ts: one done + one open task per context; Post-Round → tasks and Task Export with Finished expanded; toggle name contains the task and aria-pressed/checked matches done; axe serious/critical. — Done shown by colour / strike-through alone (WCAG 1.4.1) is a person's screenshot review.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 6 judged check(s) passed, 30 failed. Hospital Post-Round passes: 'Complete task: …' / 'Reopen task: …' with aria-pressed matching done.

产品问题：Nursing Home Post-Round task toggles have no name and no state; both Task Export screens use 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' without the task text and without aria-pressed — a screen-reader user hears the same label for every task and cannot tell which is done (oracle predicted exactly this Fail, WCAG 4.1.2).

证据：附了 8 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-22_S20 — 目录（27 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
